cv.name: Daniel Reinholt
cv.headline: Senior Project Manager | Port & Maritime IT | PRINCE2
cv.summary: Project manager with ten years in maritime logistics IT, delivering terminal operating system rollouts and customs integrations for container terminals and shipping lines. Comfortable running hybrid delivery with German and international teams.

experience.title: Senior Project Manager
bullets: Lead the rollout of a new terminal operating system across two container terminals with 1,400 users
Manage a €9.5M budget and a team of 18 across IT, operations and two external vendors
Introduced a stage-gate model for change requests, cutting unplanned scope changes by roughly a third
Coordinate cutover planning with customs authorities and the port community system

experience.title: Project Manager
bullets: Delivered the integration of the ATLAS customs interface for 60 forwarding clients
Ran steering committees and reported progress to the board on a monthly basis

experience.title: Junior Project Manager
bullets: Supported ERP migration projects for mid-sized shipping agencies
Maintained project plans, RAID logs and status reports

skills: Budget and resource planning, vendor management
Terminal operating systems, EDI, customs interfaces (ATLAS)
